All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — The provisioned dashboard (listed as "Service Health" in the Bench folder, at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has exactly **3 panels**, titled:
- **Request rate**
- **Error count**
- **Latency by endpoint**

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr53-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created (in the Bench folder) containing a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr53-n1 Availability"**. Verified via Grafana's Inspect → Panel JSON: `"type": "stat"`, `"title": "fwgr53-n1 Availability"`, data source `"type": "grafana-testdata-datasource"`, uid `benchtestdata` (TestData). Dashboard saved.

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr53-n1 Notes"** whose rendered content reads **"Bench notes for run fwgr53-n1"** (contains the runid). Verified on a fresh page reload after an explicit Save.

**4. DONE** — Tag **`bench`** added (Settings → General → Tags) and time range set to **Last 6 hours**, persisted by ticking **"Update default time range"** in the save dialog. Verified in the saved JSON Model after a fresh load with no query params: `"time": {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`, `"tags": ["bench"]`; the top bar showed "Last 6 hours" from the saved default.

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **`1m`** via the top-bar refresh-interval control, persisted by ticking **"Update default refresh value"** in the save dialog. Verified in the saved JSON Model: `"refresh": "1m"`; on a fresh load the top bar showed "1m" and the page re-applied `?refresh=1m` from the saved default.

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser address bar after opening the dashboard from the Dashboards search list:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyhsbqqljf28e/fwgr53-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **efyhsbqqljf28e**

Final state confirmed on the loaded page: title "fwgr53-n1 Bench Dashboard" (breadcrumbs Home / Dashboards / Bench), Stat panel "fwgr53-n1 Availability" rendering a value, Text panel "fwgr53-n1 Notes" with "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n1", time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m".
